title: What protects you after a leak?
instruction: A forum where you have an account has leaked. What protects you, and what doesn’t?

items.text: A different password for every service
items.why: Then the leaked password only opens that one forum.
An attacker with the password doesn’t have your phone, so they can’t log in.

items.text: The password Minecraft2023! on every service
items.why: One password everywhere: one leak opens everything.

items.text: A password manager with long random passwords
items.why: Every password is different and none can be guessed.

items.text: Adding a 1 to the end of your password
items.why: Attackers try these little changes first.

items.text: Changing the password only on the hacked forum and leaving it everywhere else
items.why: On the other services the leaked one still works.

items.text: A password made of a sentence of several words
items.why: A long password is hard to guess, even if the attacker knows its fingerprint.

debrief: A leak from one service only puts at risk the accounts that have the same password. Unique passwords and 2FA stop it.
